conventions.hamiltonian: K = (epsilon_d-mu) sum_sigma n_dsigma + U n_dup n_ddown + sum_k,sigma (epsilon_k-mu) n_ksigma + sum_k,sigma V_k (d_sigma^dag c_ksigma + h.c.)
conventions.green_function: G_sigma(tau) = -Tr[exp(-(beta-tau)K) d_sigma exp(-tau K) d_sigma^dag] / Z
conventions.hybridization: Gamma(omega) = pi * sum_k V_k^2 * delta(omega - epsilon_k)
conventions.quadrature: Gauss-Chebyshev quadrature of the second kind
conventions.target_continuum: Gamma_target(omega) = gamma * sqrt(1 - (omega / bandwidth)^2) for |omega| <= bandwidth; 0 otherwise
conventions.gamma_normalization: pi * sum_k V_k^2 = pi * gamma * bandwidth / 2
